Tokens

The colors, type, spacing and corners every class is drawn with (src/app/booster.css, section 1). Use a token, never a hex color or a px font size. The club's color is an accent only: primary buttons, the current nav item, focus rings and the logo tile.

color: var(--ink-2); padding: var(--s3) var(--s4); border-radius: var(--radius);

Color roles

--ground#f7f7f8 / #0f1012--surface#ffffff / #16181c--surface-muted#f2f2f4 / #1e2025--border#e3e4e8 / #2a2d33--border-control#cfd2d8 / #3b3f46--border-strong#8a8e98 / #6f737d--ink#18191d / #ececee--ink-2#5c606a / #a2a6ae--ink-3#8a8e98 / #6f737d--done#1f6b3d / #6cc38a--done-soft#e3f2e8 / #12301f--due#9a4a0b / #f2b36b--due-soft#fdeedc / #3a2510--late#a1231a / #ff8a80--late-soft#fbe4e2 / #3d1512--info#3b4cb8 / #a5adff--info-soft#e6e8fa / #1e2250--neutral-soft#f0f1f3 / #22252a--badge-ink#6b6b6b / #9a9aa2--clubThe club's, set at runtime--club-textThe club's, set at runtime--club-tintThe club's, set at runtime

Type scale

--text-2xl 2rem: an amount ($185.00)

--text-xl 1.5rem: a page title (1.75rem from 760px)

--text-lg 1.125rem: a card's title

--text-control 0.9375rem: buttons, nav links, table cells, a card's quiet line

--text-md 1rem: body text, the least a phone ever reads

--text-sm 0.875rem: a meta line, a label

--text-xs 0.8125rem: table headers and badges, the floor

Space and corners

Space: --s1 4px, --s2 8px, --s3 12px, --s4 16px, --s5 24px, --s6 32px, --s7 48px; the page gutter --cell is 16px on a phone and 24px from 760px. Corners: --radius 8px (cards, lists, notices, menus), --radius-control 6px (buttons, fields), --radius-badge 4px, --radius-round only for avatars and status dots. One shadow, --shadow-menu, on menus. Motion: --dur-fast 120ms and --dur 200ms, nothing at all with reduced motion.

Focus: every ring is --ring (2px, 3px in high contrast) in --focus, the mode's own club text color. Weights: 400, 500, 600, and 700 only for the club logo tile.

Contrast

Every text and ground pair the system draws, in every display mode, measured (src/lib/theme/palette.ts; tests/unit/design-tokens.test.ts fails when one falls under its floor). The club's color is derived per club to pass on every ground of its mode.

import { PALETTE, TEXT_PAIRS } from "@/lib/theme/palette";

Button and LinkButton

Button does something; LinkButton goes somewhere. One primary (the club's fill) per area; secondary for the others; quiet for a small action in a sentence or a row; danger for removing or ending. Every button is 44px tall. Busy is aria-disabled with a spinner, never disabled, on parent pages.

import { Button, LinkButton } from "@/app/components/ui";
Pay

Hover lays a light wash over the fill (secondary: the muted ground). Focus is the club's ring, 2px (3px in high contrast), drawn here on the sample. A long label wraps inside the button:

Do: a button for anything that starts, changes or moves a task on

Next: connect to QuickBooksConnect a different company

Button submits a form; LinkButton goes to an action or the next step. Primary for the one thing the step is for, secondary for the others.

Don't: an underlined link for an action or a step

Skip to step 3 · Connect a different company

A plain link is only for reading more, help, going back to where you came from (“Back to Roster”), or a record's own page in a list or table. Alone on its line it takes .link-line.

Card

A titled region of a page: what a family owes, its students, a setting. Its title names the region for screen readers. Actions sit at the foot, or beside the title with headActions. Never a card inside a card.

import { Card } from "@/app/components/ui";

Sample Family

A quiet line under the title

The card's content: words, a List, a DataTable or a form.

See your payments

A much longer title that has to wrap onto a second line on a phone

With headActions the action sits beside the title and wraps under it when there is no room.

List and ListRow

The core of the look: a bordered list of like rows, each a status icon with its words, a title, a meta line, then an amount or a compact action. Use it for To do, Students, Payments and any short list a person acts on; ListTotal under a list of amounts sums them. A long list of records with columns is a DataTable.

import { List, ListRow, ListSubRow, ListTotal, SectionLabel } from "@/app/components/ui";

EmptyState

Where a list or table has nothing yet: say what will be here, kindly, and the one action that fills it.

No volunteer events yet

When you add one, families see it on their Volunteer page.

Drawer

A form behind a button: a repeated form on a row (Waive for…, Change the student…) or a secondary one on a page. The button says what the form does; it opens a side sheet with the form, which fills a phone's screen. It has its own address (?param=value): Back closes it, a refresh opens it again, and without JavaScript the button is a link to the page with the form drawn in it. The focus goes in, stays in, and comes back to the button; Esc and Close close it.

import { Drawer } from "@/app/components/ui";Change the event

Close

ConfirmDialog

One press that needs a second look: a button with the action's words, then a small dialog with one sentence of what follows, an optional box to tick or a reason to type, and the action's own button beside Cancel (which has the focus first). Not for a form: that is a Drawer.

import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/app/components/ui";

Disconnect QuickBooks?

The portal stops reading QuickBooks. The last roster stays, marked as no longer current.

It stops counting toward what the club asks. Only staff see your reason.

RichTextEditor

A body of rich text a person writes (a club message): its label and hint over a frame with the toolbar (undo and redo, two headings, two lists, bold, italic, underline, a link, and a picture where the form takes them) and the writing area. It offers only what src/lib/messages/body.ts keeps; the server checks what it sends. The form reads what was written through its ref. Tiptap, with the look of Tiptap's Simple Editor template. Not for a line of plain text: that is a TextInput or TextArea.

import { RichTextEditor, type RichTextHandle } from "@/app/components/rich-text-editor";
Message

Some words or a picture. Headings, bold, italic, underline, lists, links and pictures.

Bulk select

Inside BulkSelect, select puts a tick box on each row ("Select" and the row's name) and one in the header, mixed when some are ticked. A bar stays in view while any are: the count, read out as it changes, the actions, and Clear; with the page ticked and more rows matching, "Select all M that match". On a phone the actions are one "N selected · Actions" button. A bulk action sends selectionPayload(), ids from the browser: the server checks every one again before it acts, and works out "all that match" from its own query. Its Drawer says first what would happen to each row, then what did.

      Notice and ActionOutcome

      A status that stands apart: information, needs attention, done, a problem. ActionOutcome shows what a server action answered. A problem is announced as an alert, the rest as a status. An answer that replaces the form that was pressed takes the focus: give it a ref (and Notice tabIndex={-1}).

      import { Notice, ActionOutcome } from "@/app/components/ui";
      Note The figures are from QuickBooks, as of 2:14 pm.
      Needs attention Two families have no sign-in yet.
      Done Saved. The club's records are up to date.
      Problem
      • Enter a phone number with 10 digits.
      • Enter a mailing address.

      Needs attention: QuickBooks needs connecting again

      Payments are paused until it is. It takes a minute.
